items.title: Coverage manifest maps acceptance IDs to stale or unrelated evidence
items.evidence: At 7bc5479919cc41ed2d68ec131b5b4a0bc4a99dc7b59236e68f47e567620c7d58, coverage-manifest.json maps PRD-AC-012/043/052/062 to symbols that disagree with approved specification rev12 section 9.11; several report anchors are stale. Runtime tests exist, so this is support traceability drift.

items.title: AudioSystem authority preamble omits Accepted ADR-0043
items.evidence: At 7bc5479919cc41ed2d68ec131b5b4a0bc4a99dc7b59236e68f47e567620c7d58, docs/AudioSystem.md documents the fixed spatial design but its authority preamble names ADR-0039..0041 and omits Accepted ADR-0043, while the ADR index correctly lists it.

items.title: Exact named acceptance evidence records are incomplete
items.evidence: At 7bc5479919cc41ed2d68ec131b5b4a0bc4a99dc7b59236e68f47e567620c7d58, 24 unique required non-Studio identities from approved specification rev12 are absent verbatim from runners/validator. AudioManualQaTestRunner/AllAcceptanceCriteriaMapped checks only 79 sequential IDs, mode and source, not semantic identity sets. Broader tests cover the behavior, so this is a nonblocking evidence identity/traceability gap.
